contract: GET /feed/:slug. Serve the slug-addressed RSS 2.0 feed XML without authentication as text/xml; charset=utf-8: channel fields derived from the persisted feed, one item per feed episode with absolute link/GUID/enclosure and a GMT pubDate, and an implicit refresh (episode ids retained) when the source entity changed since entityUpdatedAt. Unknown or closed slugs answer 404.
exceptions: force is not applicable: the read routes and the boot cleanup have no force, hard or override mode; a feed is refreshed implicitly when its entity is newer than entityUpdatedAt.
XML element order, whitespace and the exact lastBuildDate value are not asserted (only the GMT RFC1123 format).

Unexecuted upstream ranges behind these routes: RssFeedManager.js:155-156 (invalid entity type throw; only item/collection/series feeds exist), Feed.js:185-188/275-278/364-367/558-562 (transaction rollback branches; need a database failure), Feed.js:528-530 (invalid entity type in updateFeedForEntityType), Feed.js:467-469 (playlist feed afterFind; no API creates playlist feeds), RSSFeedController.js:73-75/116-118/159-161 (500 after a failed create transaction), FeedEpisode.js:224 (empty books array; opens reject entities without audio), rss/index.js:28-33 getSize and :89-97 (enclosure.file is never set by Audiobookshelf), :60-63 feed categories and item categories (never set), :131-132 geoRSS (no lat/long), :20-21 (ifTruePushArray early return; custom_elements is always an array).

invariants.contract: GET /feed/:slug answers 200 text/xml; charset=utf-8 for an existing slug with no token and no cookie. The document is RSS 2.0 (version="2.0") declaring the dc, content, atom, itunes, podcast and googleplay namespaces, with channel: CDATA title and description (description falls back to the title when the feed description is empty), link = hostPrefix+siteURL, image(url=hostPrefix+imageURL, title, link), generator 'Audiobookshelf', lastBuildDate = the generation time in GMT RFC1123, atom:link(href=hostPrefix+feedURL, rel=self, type=application/rss+xml), language = feed language or 'en', CDATA author, itunes:author (author), itunes:type (podcastType or 'serial'), itunes:image(href=hostPrefix+imageURL), itunes:explicit true|false, itunes:summary only when the description is non-empty, itunes:owner with itunes:name = ownerName||author and itunes:email only when set, and itunes:block + googleplay:block 'yes' only when preventIndexing. Every absolute URL is built from the request origin plus the router base path, never from the stored serverAddress.

Every feed episode becomes one <item> in feedEpisodes order with: CDATA title (the book title for a single-file book, a matching chapter title when chapter starts equal the track starts, else the audio file base name), link = hostPrefix+siteURL, guid = hostPrefix+enclosureURL with isPermaLink="false", dc:creator = episode author, pubDate (episode pubDate as a GMT string; audiobook feeds offset track n by n minutes from the library item createdAt), enclosure(url=hostPrefix+enclosureURL, length=enclosureSize, type=enclosureType), itunes:author, itunes:duration = round(duration), itunes:explicit true|false; podcast episodes additionally carry description and itunes:summary when non-empty and itunes:season/episode/episodeType only when set. Titles come from a matching chapter only when every chapter start is within one second of the track offset; otherwise the audio file base name is used.

A read of a feed whose library item, book, collection, series or newest podcast episode is newer than entityUpdatedAt refreshes the persisted feed in one transaction: feed fields (title, description, author, imageURL with a new ?ts=, coverPath, entityUpdatedAt) are re-derived, new episodes are inserted, episodes whose files disappeared are deleted, and episodes are matched by filePath so existing ids and therefore GUIDs are retained. A repeated read of an unchanged feed writes no row. An unknown or closed slug answers 404 and returns no XML document. A persisted feed whose source entity row disappeared while the server was stopped is removed at the next boot (RssFeedManager.init) and its slug then answers 404. A serial (or NULL-type) podcast feed orders episodes oldest first; an episodic one newest first.
